$comment: Provenance + integrity manifest for the vendored files in assets/. scripts/check-vendored-assets.mjs recomputes each sha256 from disk and fails CI on any mismatch (deterministic, offline tamper/edit gate). The scheduled .github/workflows/vendor-drift.yml separately re-checks dig-embed.js against hub's canonical source (comment-stripped) to catch upstream CODE drift. Re-vendor flow + --update usage: runbooks/deploy.md. Vendored-assets contract: SPEC.md.

assets.parity_note: This file is a PORT of hub's source, not a byte copy, and two deltas are deliberate. (1) #2313 fail-closed rootIsPinned (canonicalize root + sentinel allowlist), so this deployed asset cannot silently skip the merkle-inclusion gate for a non-canonical pinned root; hub's copy treats a malformed root as unpinned. (2) The DIG URN parser was reconciled here against hub's ratified version (hub #260, v0.30.0) rather than byte-copied, so it keeps this file's tolerant root handling (canonicalizeRoot, i.e. an 0x-prefixed root still resolves) while adopting the contract's salt-boundary and no-percent-decoding rules; the previous copy predated hub #260 and derived WRONG retrieval keys (on.dig.net#17). Agreement is no longer asserted here: tests/conformance/urn-conformance.test.mjs holds this file's parser to @dignetwork/dig-sdk/conformance/urn-parse.json, the same table hub is held to, and pins it equal to assets/sw.js. hub_ref is the hub commit this port was reconciled against; the daily vendor-drift job will report the two deltas above as code drift, which is expected.

assets.version_note: wasm-bindgen JS glue from the dig-client-wasm crate (DIG-Network/dig-store crates/dig-client-wasm). No embedded version string in the artifact; tracked from the crate's Cargo.toml version at vendor time.
